# Europe

## Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors

The Russia defence ministry said it had struck logistics hubs and supply centres in Kyiv and the surrounding region. [...] ## Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy

The player only realised they binned the life-changing ticket after family told them the numbers he played for years had been drawn.

 A teenager sits on a bicycle watching flames rise from a burning logistics warehouse following a Russian ballistic missile attack on Kyiv and the surrounding region on August 5, 2026 in Kyiv, Ukraine. 

## Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors [...] Members of the military escort migrants in Ceuta, Spain, following recent mass crossings of migrants on foot and by sea from Morocco into Spanish territory.

## How Spain's migrant crisis created a political storm - whipped up by social media

The Ceuta crossings have shaken Europe politically, exposing divisions over the sensitive issue of migration, the BBC's Sarah Rainsford writes.
